scope: Linux containers on macOS; expanded inventory, not an exhaustive specification audit
reference_engine: Must pin actual Docker Engine version, API, OS and artifact before execution; CLI version is not engine version

cases.name: version-negotiation
cases.acceptance: Negotiate supported API versions; reject unsupported versions without mutation.

cases.name: response-contracts
cases.acceptance: Compare status codes, null versus absent fields, errors and filters with reference Docker.

cases.name: http-framing
cases.acceptance: Exercise chunked trailers, Expect, keepalive and Connection close without losing request boundaries.

cases.name: exec-exit
cases.acceptance: Java and Python SDK exec returns complete stdout, stderr and integer terminal exit status.

cases.name: network-connect-status
cases.acceptance: Node Testcontainers connects an alias network and resolves its peer successfully.

cases.name: inspect-recreate
cases.acceptance: Recreate from inspect metadata and preserve mounts, ports, environment and labels.

cases.name: durable-container
cases.acceptance: Write a checksum to a container layer; restart engine; start same container and verify bytes and metadata.

cases.name: durable-tags
cases.acceptance: Local image aliases resolve to the same image after engine restart.

cases.name: restart-policy
cases.acceptance: Verify no, always, unless-stopped and on-failure across exit, explicit stop and engine restart.

cases.name: signal-init
cases.acceptance: PID 1 receives configured stop signal; init reaps zombies; timeout escalates and reports exit correctly.

cases.name: pause-update
cases.acceptance: Pause freezes progress; unpause resumes; resource update preserves unrelated configuration.

cases.name: name-races
cases.acceptance: Concurrent create with one name admits one owner; failed start releases only its owned resources.

cases.name: lost-guest-reply
cases.acceptance: Drop a guest reply; request times out and unrelated info and cancellation remain responsive.

cases.name: disk-full-recovery
cases.acceptance: Fill isolated disk during write and pull; reclaim owned data; restart and verify recovery and original checksums.

cases.name: attach-reconnect
cases.acceptance: StdinOnce false survives attach disconnect and reconnect without premature EOF.

cases.name: tty-resize
cases.acceptance: TTY allocation and resize update guest dimensions; non-TTY stdout and stderr remain separate.

cases.name: detach-keys
cases.acceptance: Detach sequence split across reads detaches without dropping ordinary input or stopping container.

cases.name: websocket-attach
cases.acceptance: WebSocket masking, ping, close, backpressure and disconnect have bounded memory and correct stream behavior.

cases.name: cap-drop
cases.acceptance: Drop ALL; inspect capability sets and prove a capability-dependent operation fails.

cases.name: cap-add
cases.acceptance: Add NET_ADMIN in a private network namespace; permitted operation succeeds without unrelated capabilities.

cases.name: read-only
cases.acceptance: Rootfs write fails while writable named volume succeeds.

cases.name: no-new-privileges
cases.acceptance: Kernel NoNewPrivs is set and a controlled setuid elevation is denied.

cases.name: seccomp
cases.acceptance: Configured syscall allow and deny behavior matches policy; unsupported profiles fail before start.

cases.name: namespace-sharing
cases.acceptance: Verify private, host and container PID and IPC modes against guest identities without contaminating supervisor namespaces.

cases.name: privileged-devices
cases.acceptance: Verify supported privileged and device access remains within VM boundary; unsupported requests fail explicitly.

cases.name: cpu-quota
cases.acceptance: Quota is applied and sustained load shows throttling; removing quota preserves other limits.

cases.name: cpu-affinity
cases.acceptance: Requested available CPUs constrain execution; invalid CPU sets are rejected atomically.

cases.name: memory-oom
cases.acceptance: Hard limit triggers expected OOM state while sibling workload remains healthy.

cases.name: reservation-swap
cases.acceptance: Reservation and memory-plus-swap combinations match reference cgroup behavior; unsupported settings are explicit.

cases.name: pids-ulimits
cases.acceptance: Fork and file-open fixtures hit configured PID and descriptor limits without exhausting guest.

cases.name: transactional-update
cases.acceptance: Invalid multi-field update leaves all previously effective limits unchanged.

cases.name: idle-burst
cases.acceptance: Database stays healthy through idle reclaim then a workload burst; verify growth and data integrity.

cases.name: reclaim-stability
cases.acceptance: Eight-hour idle-stack soak measures host footprint, guest pressure, faults and IO without recurring reclaim oscillation.

cases.name: mixed-pressure
cases.acceptance: Concurrent database and build under pressure preserve checksums, limits and bounded preparation eviction.

cases.name: general-references
cases.acceptance: Pull mutable tags and digests from public and private registries; resolve correct platform and immutable identity.

cases.name: auth-null-fields
cases.acceptance: SDK authentication with optional null fields works; invalid and expired tokens fail without leaking credentials.

cases.name: registry-tls
cases.acceptance: Custom CA and proxy paths work; untrusted certificates and cross-origin credential forwarding are rejected.

cases.name: push-digests
cases.acceptance: Push and pull roundtrip preserve manifest identity; RepoDigests contains registry digest rather than config ID.

cases.name: diffids-scanner
cases.acceptance: Inspect RootFS diff IDs match saved archive; Trivy can scan through Docker API.

cases.name: archive-roundtrip
cases.acceptance: Save and load compressed and multi-image archives preserving tags, metadata and runnable contents.

cases.name: concurrent-ingest
cases.acceptance: Concurrent loads sharing layers and canceled transfers preserve atomic image publication and reference counts.

cases.name: prune-references
cases.acceptance: Prune and replacement reclaim only unused content; referenced image and layer data remain intact.

cases.name: volume-in-use
cases.acceptance: Force removal of a volume referenced by running or stopped container is refused and checksum survives.

cases.name: volume-copyup
cases.acceptance: Named and anonymous volume population, nocopy, UID and mode match reference behavior.

cases.name: archive-ownership
cases.acceptance: Copy in and out preserve expected UID, GID, mode, links and directory-content semantics.

cases.name: host-file-events
cases.acceptance: Host create, atomic save, rename and delete emit events and trigger application reload.

cases.name: host-permissions
cases.acceptance: Parallel non-root creates and renames preserve permission semantics without intermittent EACCES.

cases.name: filesystem-metadata
cases.acceptance: Exercise xattrs, hardlinks, sparse files, locking and fsync on supported mount types.

cases.name: mount-paths
cases.acceptance: Bind ExternalSSD paths with spaces and Unicode; distinguish host case sensitivity from guest volume behavior.

cases.name: tmpfs-options
cases.acceptance: Tmpfs size, UID, GID and mode apply even when image target directory is absent.

cases.name: project-dns
cases.acceptance: Two Compose projects using same service names resolve only their own peers.

cases.name: application-dns
cases.acceptance: Go gRPC, Node and JVM resolvers connect successfully over sustained requests.

cases.name: network-mutation
cases.acceptance: Connect and disconnect first and secondary networks; update aliases and release DNS listeners.

cases.name: internal-isolation
cases.acceptance: Internal network prevents egress while allowed peers communicate; configured bridge isolation is enforced.

cases.name: ports
cases.acceptance: TCP and UDP publication, loopback versus LAN binding, ephemeral ports and collisions match selected platform contract.

cases.name: idle-stream
cases.acceptance: Keep a TCP session idle beyond five minutes then transfer bytes without unexpected disconnect.

cases.name: host-access
cases.acceptance: Reach macOS IPv4 and IPv6 loopback services using documented host gateway behavior.

cases.name: dual-stack
cases.acceptance: IPv4 and IPv6 static endpoints, IPAM and inspection agree with actual connectivity.

cases.name: vpn-proxy
cases.acceptance: Approved split-tunnel VPN and proxy fixtures resolve and route correctly without altering host networking globally.

cases.name: dockerfile
cases.acceptance: Test each pinned Dockerfile instruction and flag through separate parametrized fixtures, including multi-stage and ignore rules.

cases.name: cache-invalidation
cases.acceptance: Unchanged, source-only and dependency changes reuse only valid cache; outputs have expected checksums.

cases.name: secret-ssh
cases.acceptance: Secret and SSH sessions work; secret material is absent from final image, history and exported cache.

cases.name: drivers
cases.acceptance: Qualify default docker and docker-container drivers separately with explicit capability reporting.

cases.name: outputs
cases.acceptance: Load, OCI, local and registry outputs preserve identity; built image is immediately inspectable and runnable.

cases.name: cancel-concurrent
cases.acceptance: Concurrent builds plus cancellation clean mounts and processes without corrupting cache or sibling build.

cases.name: contexts-bake
cases.acceptance: Named and remote contexts, cache import/export and Bake targets produce expected artifacts.

cases.name: config-resolution
cases.acceptance: Overrides, interpolation, env files, profiles, includes and relative paths match pinned official Compose processing.

cases.name: health-dependencies
cases.acceptance: Started, healthy and completed dependencies plus up wait enforce actual readiness and failure semantics.

cases.name: resource-fields
cases.acceptance: Compose limits, reservations and capabilities reach actual cgroup and process state; no silent ineffective settings.

cases.name: secrets-configs
cases.acceptance: File and supported environment sources mount with correct targets and access; missing sources fail before start.

cases.name: lifecycle-scale
cases.acceptance: Scale, recreate, restart, orphan removal and down preserve or remove resources according to flags.

cases.name: watch-hooks
cases.acceptance: Supported watch and lifecycle hooks execute in correct order; failures and unsupported configuration are explicit.

cases.name: build-pull-policy
cases.acceptance: Up build and pull policy select correct artifact; project build secrets and additional contexts function.

cases.name: testcontainers
cases.acceptance: Run pinned Java, Node, Python, Go and .NET fixtures including readiness, exec, networks and cleanup.

cases.name: devcontainers
cases.acceptance: Open a pinned development fixture with mounts, non-root user, exec and rebuild; verify file edits.

cases.name: database-stack
cases.acceptance: Application plus PostgreSQL, Redis and reverse proxy serves requests across recreate and engine restart.

cases.name: help-no-effects
cases.acceptance: All help and version commands leave processes, Docker config, shell profiles and startup registrations unchanged.

cases.name: socket-coexistence
cases.acceptance: Explicit test context remains isolated; startup and stop do not replace production socket or selected context.

cases.name: upgrade-rollback
cases.acceptance: Installed candidate preserves supported data across upgrade and documented rollback using isolated copies.

cases.name: single-node
cases.acceptance: Init and leave plus service create, inspect and remove expose correct task lifecycle.

cases.name: update-rollback
cases.acceptance: Rolling service update, failure rollback, replicas and job modes follow declared policy.

cases.name: secrets-configs
cases.acceptance: Service secrets and configs have expected permissions, lifecycle and access restrictions.

cases.name: overlay-routing
cases.acceptance: Multi-node overlay discovery, VIP and routing mesh reach healthy tasks across nodes.

cases.name: quorum-recovery
cases.acceptance: Three managers survive leader loss; partition and recovery preserve agreed state without duplicate ownership.

cases.name: amd64
cases.acceptance: Foreign-platform pull, build and execution use emulation correctly or fail explicitly before execution.

cases.name: plugins
cases.acceptance: Each advertised volume, network and logging plugin contract passes lifecycle and failure tests.

cases.name: gpu-cdi
cases.acceptance: Advertised GPU or CDI devices perform a real workload; unavailable hardware is not reported as supported.

cases.name: rootless-checkpoint
cases.acceptance: Rootless and checkpoint restore require separate declared capability fixtures; unsupported modes remain explicit.
